_source: near_identical: the title cosine (similarity model) at or above which action_center._same_story calls two issues one story. Fitted by backend/scripts/calibrate_near_identical.py (action_center.fit_near_identical_cut) on pairs the stored issues label themselves: the same source article, national monitor or bill is one story, different monitors on different days are two, and so are two feed articles about one actor whose own text dates them days apart (stated_day_negatives); other pairs left out. The lowest cosine no different-story pair reaches, plus CUT_MARGIN, with at least MIN_HARD_NEGATIVES such pairs, adopted only under precision_rule.accept against the cut in use (held out on blocks of days). The refresh refits it daily. Fitted and adopted on this snapshot.
